scope: Two fixed seated Joker ME1 drawings with chair included; art and source-image checks only, no cockpit integration claim.

primaryReference.observed: Top-left screenshot on printed62 shows a capped pilot seated in the foreground; adjacent text identifies Joker at the controls and Kaidan also stationed at the helm. Posture, cap and upper clothing only.
primaryReference.limitation: No complete body, chair geometry, costume details or exact generated likeness certified; PDF17 principal screenshots concern other characters.

visualReview.method: Chromium loads the unchanged native PNG over a temporary loopback HTTP server and displays it on an opaque #28323f page background. A full-size browser screenshot was actually opened. This is an image preview, not WorldView.
visualReview.previewQualification: Direct view_image of the native RGBA PNG displayed anomalously dark despite correct sampled face pixels (233,174,148,253). Initial file:// browser navigation was blocked by administrator policy; ordinary loopback HTTP was used. The delivered asset was never rewritten.
observations: Both figures are clearly sitting, with distinct calm/controls hand and head poses.
Cap, beard, adult proportions, navy/gold prototype clothing and chair design remain coherent across the two drawings.
Complete legs, boots, chair backs and bases remain inside their isolated rectangles; no neighbour is cropped into either frame.
Chair/boots use a measured horizontal seat-base anchor and lowest visible boot baseline.
Minor facial, cloth and chair details are generated interpretations; no original-game geometry comparison is claimed.

limits: Two fixed drawings do not provide a motion cycle, actual piloting, locomotion or a gameplay feature.
Idle is intended for the Normandy cockpit actor; pilot is a separate inspection drawing until a renderer use is explicitly added.
Very low alpha fringe pixels persist outside crops and one alpha1 pixel level reaches the left image edge; renderer-visible pixels all stay within padded crops.
All canonical art and exact original costume fidelity remain unverified; no gameplay statistic, recruitment, inventory or save changes are supplied by this asset.
